item.title: GPS Jamming Emerging as Major Warfare Tactic, Disrupting Ships and Aircraft
item.description: A growing tactic in modern warfare is creating serious concerns for global transportation and safety: GPS jamming.As the war involving Iran escalates, ships operating in nearby waters have reported major disruptions to their navigation systems. In some cases, vessels suddenly appeared on navigation maps as if they were located at airports, power plants, or even on land.The confusion is caused by jamming and spoofing of signals from global navigation satellite systems, including GPS. item.title: January 6 Capitol Police plaque quietly installed at U.S. Capitol after years of delay
item.description: A long-delayed commemorative plaque honoring the law enforcement officers who defended the U.S. Capitol during the January 6, 2021 attack has finally been installed.The plaque appeared early Saturday morning inside the U.S. Capitol near an entrance on the building’s West Front. item.title: More than 60 dogs rescued from Riverside County house fire as shelters reach 300% capacity
item.description: More than 60 dogs are safe after Riverside County Animal Services rescued them from a house fire near eastern Hemet.The rescue happened Thursday, when crews responded to a home where dozens of dogs were inside during the fire. item.description: A group of high school students in San Jose is gaining international attention after developing an artificial intelligence system designed to detect and suppress wildfires within minutes.The team from Valley Christian High School, known as Wildfire Quest, has been named a finalist in the $11 million XPRIZE Wildfire competition. item.title: Coachella Valley Girls Soccer Heads to State Finals Game, Crowned Regional Champs
item.description: The Lady Mighty Arabs continue their historic season on the pitch with a victory over San Jacinto.Jaylynn Hernandez scored a goal, and Daniela Pineda knocked in two to secure the CIF Division 4 Regional Championship Title.Next stop - Sacramento. Where the team will take on Marin Catholic for the State Championship.The state final game will be played Friday, March 13th. For more Coachella Valley News visit NBCPalmSprings.com
